alt_text: Cover: Mug smarter, not longer. 5 study habits that work for any subject.

Habit 1, understand don't memorise: memorised steps break when a question changes, so we explain the why behind every idea. Habit 2, little and often: spreading study over days beats cramming, so we post one short page a day.

Habit 3, test yourself: recalling from memory beats rereading, so we post a weekly quiz. Habit 4, learn from mistakes: misreading the question, stopping an explanation halfway, skipping the final check.
Habit 5, a head start beats a last-minute rush, and the weekly schedule from Monday study notes to Sunday real life.
